item.title: Bailey Guffin named men’s soccer coach at Georgia Southwestern
item.description: Georgia Southwestern State University Director of Athletics Mike Leeder has announced the hiring of Bailey Guffin as the next head coach of the Hurricanes men's soccer program. Guffin will officially begin his duties on April 8.

item.title: Hawks continue home court dominance, run away from Grizzlies
item.description: Nickeil Alexander-Walker scored 26 points — 22 in the first half — and the Atlanta Hawks won their 11th straight home game on Monday, a 146-107 victory over the struggling Memphis Grizzlies.

item.title: ASU, SRTC expand agreement to grow teacher pipeline
item.description: Officials say the latest expansion responds directly to workforce needs, particularly the growing demand for qualified teachers. While investments in technology and STEM fields continue to increase, education leaders say persistent challenges — including stagnant salaries and professional burnout — have contributed to ongoing teacher shortages.

item.title: Albany’s Fussell Hughes to assume role as national Exchange Club president
item.description: “I’m just lucky to be where I’m at. I get to meet people. I get to spread the word of Exchange. We’re also in a growing mode, so I’ll continue to do that, too. My job is to spread the word of Exchange.”
